title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is edging down. Kula Ag had mostly shade over the last hour; the cloud tops out between about 6,900 and 8,500 ft, with sun above it. Upslope has run since about 08:15 at a light 3 mph, and thermals seem flat. Trades are holding the shear line on Makawao Avenue near Makawao, running toward Kahului, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
